units.source_text: 父親讓我從四年級開始報考高中，

en.t: My father had me start taking high school entrance examinations from the fourth year,

units.source_text: 而我自己也正好對海邊的櫻花中學感到了厭倦，

en.t: and I myself had just grown tired of the Sakura middle school by the sea,

units.source_text: 所以沒上五年級，上完四年級後我直接考進了東京的高中，開始了寄宿學校的生活。

en.t: so instead of going on to the fifth year, after finishing the fourth year I went straight into a high school in Tokyo and began life in a dormitory.

units.source_text: 可是，宿舍的骯髒和粗暴讓我實在難以忍受，根本沒心情和餘力去搞笑，

en.t: But the filth and roughness of the dormitory were more than I could bear, and I had neither the mood nor the strength left for clowning around,

units.source_text: 我懇請醫生幫我開了一張「肺浸潤」的診斷書，搬出了學生宿舍，住進父親位於上野櫻花町的別墅。

en.t: so I begged a doctor to write me a diagnosis of pulmonary infiltration, moved out of the student dormitory, and went to live in my father's villa in Ueno Sakuragicho.

units.source_text: 我無論如何都無法適應集體生活，

en.t: No matter what I did, I could not adapt to communal life,

units.source_text: 什麼「青春的感動」，什麼「年輕人的驕傲」，這類話聽著就渾身打戰，

en.t: and phrases like "the passion of youth" or "the pride of young people" made me shudder just to hear them,

units.source_text: 「高中生的蓬勃朝氣」也與我格格不入。

en.t: while "the vigorous spirit of high school students" was utterly foreign to me too.
